description: CURRENCY SIGN ... WITH PICTURE SYMBOL, ISO §2023:12.3.7 - the symbol-separate form is a COBOL-2002 introduction. THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): the ANSI X3.23-1985 SPECIAL-NAMES paragraph prints the bare clause (§1985:VI.4.5.2: `[CURRENCY SIGN IS literal-6]`), and §1985:VI.4.5.4 GR11 limits it to one character that is itself the PICTURE symbol: "The literal must be nonnumeric and is limited to a single character"; §2002:12.2.6.2 SR20 adds "If the PICTURE SYMBOL phrase is specified, literal-7 may have any length" (SR19: "If the PICTURE SYMBOL phrase is not specified, literal-7 shall consist of a single character"), and §2002:F.2 item 44 states the change: "The CURRENCY SIGN clause has been extended to allow for national characters and for multiple distinct currency signs, which may have any length." §2014:12.3.6.2 SR23 and §2023:12.3.7.3 SR23 carry it: "If the PICTURE SYMBOL phrase is specified, literal-7 is the currency string and literal-8 is the associated currency symbol". Pinned pre-band code COBOL0893 (VCR Table 7 row 7.3).
